description: Basilisk combines C/C++ simulation modules with Python configuration for spacecraft orbit and attitude studies. It supports repeatable Monte Carlo runs and real-time hardware-in-the-loop configurations on major desktop operating systems. The resource is documented by University of Colorado AVS Lab and LASP. The verified page defines the resource scope; exact spatial resolution, time span and update frequency are not established by this review. The documentation is publicly accessible. Licence: ISC. Access is described as free. Only provider metadata and documentation were inspected; runnable files, underlying datasets and claimed results were not tested. The documented functions can inform infrastructure simulation inputs, intervention comparisons or operational scenarios. Numerical performance was not independently checked. No directly related catalogue record was established; no compatibility is implied.
